key: \PN obtained PULSE Read-Out 06!
en: \PN obtained PULSE Read-Out 06!
ja: \PNは　PULSEデータ06を　手に入れた!

key: PULSE Dex updated!
en: PULSE Dex updated!
ja: パルス図鑑を　更新した!

key: We've already introduced a couple new species to this area, but to make sure each new one gets along, we keep close watch over them here.
en: We've already introduced a couple new species to this area, but to make sure each new one gets along, we keep close watch over them here.
ja: すでに　この地域には　新しい種を　何種か　導入していますが　それぞれが　うまく　なじめるように　ここで　しっかりと　見守っています。

key: Ah! I've heard about you!
en: Ah! I've heard about you!
ja: ああ! あなたのことは　聞いていますよ!

key: You're that Trainer who provided the rest of the funding we needed to rebuild this place.
en: You're that Trainer who provided the rest of the funding we needed to rebuild this place.
ja: ここを　再建するのに　必要だった残りの資金を　出してくれた　トレーナーさんですね。

key: Truly, young Trainer, you have my sincerest gratitude.
en: Truly, young Trainer, you have my sincerest gratitude.
ja: 本当に　若きトレーナーさん　心から　感謝しています。

key: Repopulating the region, starting with just this island, has been a dream of mine ever since Reborn fell into decline.
en: Repopulating the region, starting with just this island, has been a dream of mine ever since Reborn fell into decline.
ja: この島から　地方全体の　生態系を　再生させることは　リボーンが　衰退して以来　わたしの夢でした。

key: Thank you so much for making this possible once again. I will not forget your kindness.
en: Thank you so much for making this possible once again. I will not forget your kindness.
ja: それを　もう一度　可能にしてくれて　本当に　ありがとうございます。あなたの親切は　決して　忘れません。

key: Welcome, Trainer. This here is the newly reopened Azurine Nature Center.
en: Welcome, Trainer. This here is the newly reopened Azurine Nature Center.
ja: ようこそ　トレーナーさん。ここが　新しく　再開した　アズリン自然センターです。

key: We're working with our sister facility up in Aventurine to make sure all kinds of species have a safe home in Reborn.
en: We're working with our sister facility up in Aventurine to make sure all kinds of species have a safe home in Reborn.
ja: あらゆる種が　リボーンで　安全な住処を　持てるように　アベンチュリンにある　姉妹施設と　協力して　取り組んでいます。

key: We're currently repopulating this island with certain species. If you find them out in the wild, you're free to catch them, but please take only what you need.
en: We're currently repopulating this island with certain species. If you find them out in the wild, you're free to catch them, but please take only what you need.
ja: 現在　この島に　特定の種を　再導入しています。野生で　見かけたら　自由に　捕まえてもらって構いませんが　必要な分だけに　してください。

key: There was a bunch of junk left over here from when we tore up the old building.
en: There was a bunch of junk left over here from when we tore up the old building.
ja: 古い建物を　取り壊したときの　がらくたが　ここに　たくさん　残っています。

key: Most of it was useless, but some of it's still laying around.
en: Most of it was useless, but some of it's still laying around.
ja: ほとんどは　使い物にならないけど　まだ　いくつか　残っているものも　あります。

key: If there's anything here you can use, feel free to take it.
en: If there's anything here you can use, feel free to take it.
ja: 使えそうなものが　あれば　遠慮なく　持っていってください。

key: Let's see... Next we should introduce...
en: Let's see... Next we should introduce...
ja: そうですね……　次に　導入するべきは……

key: Shroomish, maybe?
en: Shroomish, maybe?
ja: キノココかな?

key: It would be most appropriate for this sort of habitat.
en: It would be most appropriate for this sort of habitat.
ja: こういう生息地には　もってこいでしょう。

key: Of course, that may not happen any time soon at the rate the Bulbasaur project is going.
en: Of course, that may not happen any time soon at the rate the Bulbasaur project is going.
ja: もっとも　フシギダネ計画の　今の進み具合だと　しばらく先の話に　なりそうですが。

key: Hello there, \PN!
en: Hello there, \PN!
ja: こんにちは\PN!

key: I received word from the Grand Hall that you might be coming by to assist with our restoration program!
en: I received word from the Grand Hall that you might be coming by to assist with our restoration program!
ja: 大ホールから　あなたが　復興プログラムの手伝いに　来てくれるかもしれないと　連絡を　受けました!

key: Thank you so much for being able and generous enough to offer your time to the Azurine Center on top of your already valuable time!
en: Thank you so much for being able and generous enough to offer your time to the Azurine Center on top of your already valuable time!
ja: ただでさえ　貴重なお時間を　アズリンセンターにまで　割いていただけるなんて　本当に　寛大で　ありがたいことです!

key: In the near future, we're primarily looking to introduce two species to the Azurine ecosystem:
en: In the near future, we're primarily looking to introduce two species to the Azurine ecosystem:
ja: 近い将来　主に　二種類の生物を　アズリンの生態系に　導入したいと　考えています。

key: Pansage and Fomantis.
en: Pansage and Fomantis.
ja: ヤナップと　カリキリです。

key: In order to do this, we'll need a pair of mature Lurantis, one male and one female, and a pair of adult Simisage, again, one male and female each.
en: In order to do this, we'll need a pair of mature Lurantis, one male and one female, and a pair of adult Simisage, again, one male and female each.
ja: そのためには　成熟したラランテスの　オスとメス　一体ずつ　そして　成体のヤナッキーも　同じく　オスとメス　一体ずつ　必要です。

key: In short, we're having trouble aquiring these pairs for breeding, and could use your help.
en: In short, we're having trouble aquiring these pairs for breeding, and could use your help.
ja: 要するに　繁殖用の　このペアを　入手するのに　苦労していまして　お力を　お借りしたいのです。

key: If you're able to contribute them to the Center, we're prepared to offer you a notable reward.
en: If you're able to contribute them to the Center, we're prepared to offer you a notable reward.
ja: もし　センターに　提供していただけるなら　それなりの謝礼を　ご用意する　つもりです。

key: Would you be willing to do this?
en: Would you be willing to do this?
ja: お願い　できますか?

key: Oh, that's wonderful! You are every bit as benevolent as I expected.
en: Oh, that's wonderful! You are every bit as benevolent as I expected.
ja: ああ　なんて　すばらしい! 想像していたとおり　あなたは　本当に　寛大な方ですね。

key: So, as I said, we'll need the Pokémon to be fully evolved.
en: So, as I said, we'll need the Pokémon to be fully evolved.
ja: それで　先ほども　言いましたが　ポケモンは　完全に　進化したものが　必要です。

key: Fomantis will evolve at a high enough level provided they get plenty of daylight, but Pansage only evolves through evolutionary stones.
en: Fomantis will evolve at a high enough level provided they get plenty of daylight, but Pansage only evolves through evolutionary stones.
ja: カリキリは　十分な日光を　浴びながら　高いレベルに　達すれば　進化しますが　ヤナップは　進化の石でしか　進化しません。

key: Fortunately, we've already been able to procure those for this purpose.
en: Fortunately, we've already been able to procure those for this purpose.
ja: 幸い　そのために　すでに　石は　用意できています。

key: Please take these.
en: Please take these.
ja: どうぞ　こちらを。

key: \PN received 2 Leaf Stones!
en: \PN received 2 Leaf Stones!
ja: \PNは　リーフのいしを　2つ　受け取った!

key: You can use those on the final specimens for Simisage. Just make sure the genders are correct!
en: You can use those on the final specimens for Simisage. Just make sure the genders are correct!
ja: それを　ヤナッキーに　なる最後の個体に　使ってください。ただし　性別だけは　間違えないように!

key: We'll be awaiting your good news, so please come talk to me any time you have a specimen, or would like to check what's still needed.
en: We'll be awaiting your good news, so please come talk to me any time you have a specimen, or would like to check what's still needed.
ja: 良い知らせを　お待ちしています。個体を　手に入れたときや　あと何が　必要か　確認したいときは　いつでも　声を　かけてください。

key: Oh? That's too bad.
en: Oh? That's too bad.
ja: あら? それは　残念です。

key: We have no wish to disrespect your time, but should you ever change your mind, please come find us!
en: We have no wish to disrespect your time, but should you ever change your mind, please come find us!
ja: あなたの時間を　むだにするつもりは　ありませんが　もし　気が変わったら　いつでも　訪ねてきてくださいね!

key: The Pokémon specimens we're still waiting on are...
en: The Pokémon specimens we're still waiting on are...
ja: まだ　お待ちしている　ポケモンの個体は……

key: Female Lurantis...
en: Female Lurantis...
ja: メスの　ラランテス……

key: Male Lurantis...
en: Male Lurantis...
ja: オスの　ラランテス……

key: Female Simisage...
en: Female Simisage...
ja: メスの　ヤナッキー……

key: Male Simisage...
en: Male Simisage...
ja: オスの　ヤナッキー……

key: ...And that's about it!
en: ...And that's about it!
ja: ……以上です!

key: Do you have any of these for us?
en: Do you have any of these for us?
ja: このうち　どれか　お持ちですか?

key: Any of them that you can get for us will be extraordinarily helpful!
en: Any of them that you can get for us will be extraordinarily helpful!
ja: どれでも　手に入れて　いただけたら　本当に　助かります!

key: Oh? It seems that you've already provided that specimen for us.
en: Oh? It seems that you've already provided that specimen for us.
ja: あら? その個体は　もう　いただいているようですね。

key: But if you do find one of the others, please bring it to us!
en: But if you do find one of the others, please bring it to us!
ja: でも　他のものが　見つかったら　ぜひ　持ってきてください!

key: Oh, that's just what we'll need!
en: Oh, that's just what we'll need!
ja: あら　それこそ　必要としていたものです!

key: Thank you for fetching it for us; rest assured, we'll make sure it's healthy and happy!
en: Thank you for fetching it for us; rest assured, we'll make sure it's healthy and happy!
ja: 持ってきてくれて　ありがとうございます。健康で　幸せに　過ごせるよう　しっかり　お世話しますので　ご安心を!

key: ...Oh! That's just about everything, isn't it?
en: ...Oh! That's just about everything, isn't it?
ja: ……あら! これで　ほとんど　そろいましたね?

key: Lovely! In that case we'll begin breeding right away!
en: Lovely! In that case we'll begin breeding right away!
ja: すばらしい! それでは　さっそく　繁殖を　始めます!

key: You won't be likely to see them in the wild here any time in the immediate future, but rest assured, we'll get them ready for it in due process.
en: You won't be likely to see them in the wild here any time in the immediate future, but rest assured, we'll get them ready for it in due process.
ja: すぐには　野生で　見かけることは　ないでしょうが　しかるべき手順を踏んで　準備を　進めていきますので　ご安心を。

key: Thank you so much for your help~
en: Thank you so much for your help~
ja: 本当に　助かりました　ありがとうございます〜

key: As a reward, an associate of mine at the Grand Hall office should have something for you.
en: As a reward, an associate of mine at the Grand Hall office should have something for you.
ja: お礼として　大ホールの　事務所にいる知人が　何か　用意しているはずです。

key: Until later!
en: Until later!
ja: また　のちほど!

key: The Restoration Project is going smoothly, all thanks to your efforts!
en: The Restoration Project is going smoothly, all thanks to your efforts!
ja: 復興プロジェクトは　あなたの尽力の　おかげで　順調に　進んでいます!

key: I hope the reward at the Grand Hall can be worth it!
en: I hope the reward at the Grand Hall can be worth it!
ja: 大ホールでの　ご褒美が　それに　見合うものであれば　いいのですが!

key: Ah, I see...
en: Ah, I see...
ja: ああ　なるほど……

key: So if you have both Shelmet and Karrablast in your party, you can use a Link Stone to evolve one of them directly...
en: So if you have both Shelmet and Karrablast in your party, you can use a Link Stone to evolve one of them directly...
ja: つまり　チョボマキと　カブルモを　両方　手持ちに　入れていれば　リンクストーンを使って　どちらかを　直接　進化させられる　というわけですね……

key: Interesting how that works...
en: Interesting how that works...
ja: なかなか　面白い仕組みですね……

key: Ah, so it's important to maintain precise environmental control for this species...
en: Ah, so it's important to maintain precise environmental control for this species...
ja: ああ　この種にとっては　環境を　厳密に　管理することが　重要なんですね……

key: But the weather patterns here can be less than accommodating, can't they?
en: But the weather patterns here can be less than accommodating, can't they?
ja: でも　ここの天候は　あまり　都合よく　いかないことも　ありますよね?

key: Hm, this will be a unique challenge...
en: Hm, this will be a unique challenge...
ja: うーん　これは　なかなかの難題に　なりそうです……

key: If only I could enter a password like "weathermod" which would allow me to select the weather from my PokéGear...
en: If only I could enter a password like "weathermod" which would allow me to select the weather from my PokéGear...
ja: 「weathermod」みたいな　パスワードを　入力するだけで　ポケギアから　天候を　選べたら　いいのですが……

key: Alas, I'm sure it would disrupt regional weather currents far beyond Reborn.
en: Alas, I'm sure it would disrupt regional weather currents far beyond Reborn.
ja: でも　きっと　リボーンをはるかに超えて　地方全体の気流を　乱してしまうでしょうね。

key: Ah well.
en: Ah well.
ja: まあ　仕方ありません。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
